messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Recap: Pilot alignment & next steps (Peregrine Labs)

Tara — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap so we have the same view and a practical path to a pilot. Short version up top, details and owners below.

Top pain and goals we heard
- Latency spikes and unpredictable cost when serving 1:1 conversations at scale (primary pain).
- Need to reduce per-interaction inference cost by ~50% while keeping response quality.
- Compliance requirement: VPC-only deployment for PHI-sensitive workflows.

Pilot success criteria (what Peregrine expects)
1) 99th percentile latency < 350ms for 1-2k concurrent users
2) >= 45% reduction in per-session token cost vs current baseline
3) Validated private deployment pattern (VPC) and KMS integration

Proposed mutual decision roadmap (milestones, owners, dates)
- Milestone A: Technical sandbox + sample dataset loaded — Owner: Aditya Rao — Target: 2026-11-17
- Milestone B: Pilot performance run (1 week steady-state) — Owner: Peregrine (Rajesh) + Redwood tech ops — Target: 2026-11-30
- Milestone C: Security review & compliance checklist signed — Owner: Monica Patel — Target: 2026-12-07
- Milestone D: Procurement & PO signed — Owner: Tara Nguyen — Target: 2026-12-14

Decision process and stakeholders
- Peregrine technical sign-off: Rajesh Kumar (Eng Lead)
- Procurement / Legal: Tara Nguyen (Procurement)
- Redwood approval: Monica Patel (Enterprise Customer Success) + Security (ad hoc)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Aditya: can you confirm sandbox resources and ETA to have the sample dataset imported? (action: Aditya)
- Tara: please confirm the procurement timeline above or let us know if the 12/14 PO date is optimistic (action: Tara)
- Karthik/Monica: I'll send calendar invites for the sandbox handoff and a security scoping call this week.

Attached: PL_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, simple owner/date matrix)

Thanks — I think this is a very achievable timeline if we keep the sandbox work tight.

--
